domains.label: Registration & structure
domains.question: Is your business registered in the form that fits what it does (business name, limited company or incorporated trustees)?
domains.issue: The legal form of a business decides who owns it, who is liable and how it can grow. A form that no longer fits creates avoidable risk.
domains.action: Confirm your registration details and whether the structure still suits your plans for ownership, liability and funding.
domains.how: Compare your current registration with your actual activity and ownership, then adjust or restructure where they no longer match.
domains.help: SCS handles registrations, restructuring and post-incorporation corporate support, so the foundation matches the business.

domains.label: Licences & compliance
domains.question: Do you know which licences, permits and registrations your activity needs, and are they current?
domains.issue: Operating without a required licence, permit or filing exposes the business to penalties and interruptions.
domains.action: List every registration your activity needs and check which are in place, due or missing.
domains.how: Map your activity to the relevant agencies, keep a simple register of each permit and its renewal, and review it regularly.
domains.help: SCS maps regulatory requirements, prepares filings and follows up renewals through its compliance support.

domains.label: Tax & financial records
domains.question: Are your tax registrations in place, with returns made and financial records kept up to date?
domains.issue: Gaps in tax registration or record-keeping make filings stressful and weaken your position with banks, partners and investors.
domains.action: Confirm your tax registrations and bring your bookkeeping up to date.
domains.how: Separate business and personal finances, keep a monthly record of income and expenses, and calendar your filing obligations.
domains.help: SCS supports tax registration, compliance, bookkeeping and reporting, and coordinates specialist professionals where required.

domains.label: Contracts & agreements
domains.question: Are your key customer, supplier and staff arrangements in written, signed agreements?
domains.issue: Verbal or informal arrangements are hard to enforce and leave the business exposed when relationships change.
domains.action: Put your most important relationships into written agreements and keep signed copies in one place.
domains.how: Start with your highest-value customer, supplier and staff arrangements, use clear terms for scope, payment and exit, and track renewal dates.
domains.help: SCS drafts, reviews and manages commercial contracts and can set up a contract register.

domains.label: People & HR
domains.question: Do your staff have written terms, clear roles and organised personnel records?
domains.issue: Unclear roles and missing employment documents lead to disputes, weak accountability and compliance gaps.
domains.action: Give every role a written description and every employee written terms, and keep personnel records organised.
domains.how: Use a standard employment letter, a simple staff register and written policies for leave, conduct and performance.
domains.help: SCS supports recruitment, onboarding, HR administration, policies and outsourced HR administration.

domains.label: Data protection
domains.question: Do you have a privacy notice and a clear record of the personal data you collect and why?
domains.issue: Collecting personal data without documented purposes and safeguards creates legal and reputational risk.
domains.action: List the personal data you hold, why you hold it, who can access it and how long you keep it.
domains.how: Publish a clear privacy notice, limit access to what staff need, and write down how requests and incidents are handled.
domains.help: SCS builds data protection compliance programmes, privacy documentation and staff training.

domains.label: Brand & IP
domains.question: Have you checked and protected your business name, logo or products as business assets?
domains.issue: An unprotected name or logo can be copied or lost, and the goodwill you build may not belong to you.
domains.action: Check that your name, logo and key products are available and decide which should be protected.
domains.how: Search existing records for conflicts, keep records of who created your brand assets, and file for protection where it matters.
domains.help: SCS supports trademark, copyright and patent coordination and IP portfolio administration.

domains.label: Operations & systems
domains.question: Are your core processes (sales, records, follow-ups) written down and tracked in one place?
domains.issue: When processes live in people's heads, work slips, handovers fail and growth adds chaos instead of profit.
domains.action: Write down your three most important processes and decide where each is tracked.
domains.how: Document the steps and owners, use a simple tracker or CRM, and review it weekly.
domains.help: SCS develops SOPs, workflows and operational reporting, and can act as an outsourced operations team.

domains.label: Strategy & growth
domains.question: Do you have a written plan with targets for the next 12 months?
domains.issue: Without written targets, effort drifts and it is hard to tell what is working.
domains.action: Write a one-page plan with three measurable targets and the actions behind them.
domains.how: Choose targets for revenue, customers and operations, assign owners and review them monthly.
domains.help: SCS supports business strategy, growth planning, analytics and performance improvement.
